rows.behavior: kmctl decision supersede OLD --by NEW sets the old record's status to deprecated and leaves its body and decision_status as they were.
rows.fails_when: status is not deprecated, decision_status changed, or any line of the old body before the appended section changed

rows.behavior: The old record gets an appended dated Correction section linking the new record, and the new record links back.
rows.fails_when: either link is missing or the section is not dated

rows.behavior: The decisions index marks the old entry as superseded by the new ADR and keeps its link.
rows.fails_when: the old entry lacks the superseded note or loses its link

rows.behavior: A dated log line names both concept ids, and the bundle passes the pinned okf validator in strict mode.
rows.fails_when: log.md has no new line naming both ids, or the strict validator exits nonzero

rows.behavior: It refuses, writing nothing, when either record does not exist or OLD is already deprecated.
rows.fails_when: any file changes, or the command exits 0, in any of the three cases
